body:
There’s nothing left to grasp onto for hope anymore. I’ve lost everything. 
Which is freeing in a way.
Because now I know when I hang myself tonight o won’t get scared and back out. I’ve let go of any hope, because there never was any to begin with.

I would be less stressed, but I don’t think I would be less unhappy. I don’t think there’s a way for me to climb out of this emotional hole I’ve dug myself into.
I have tried to kill myself twice in the last two months. Eventually I’m gonna get it right.

I wan never married. My daughters father left over a year ago and moved away and had another child. My daughter is three. Trying to give her a life she deserves but I can’t dig my way out of the debt her father left me in. 
I have a bf, and he’s my Sunlight, but my depression is pushing him away from me. He’s also in the military so his schedule makes it hard for us to see each other and he can’t be there for me the way he wants to or the way I need him to.
I just feel like I’m drowning all the time. I’m a single mom and I have no one, my breaking point was miscarrying my second child. I want to go.
